description: Replace the tracks of the path: 0 to 3 different ways to reach the same aim (e.g. two products that could each earn the target), each with its own milestones and current milestone. reach says how this track alone would reach the aim. milestoneIds puts those milestones into the track, in that order. An empty list makes the path one list again. Use tracks only when the user chooses to work on more than one way; never present one track as the wrong one.

reach.description: how this track alone reaches the aim, e.g. "about 24 yearly plans sold in December"

name: set_tracks
title: Set tracks
